systems.system: Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth (Project BRIDGE)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, through a special purpose vehicle with 25-49% government and at least 51% private shareholding
systems.tiers: all 36 states and the FCT, 'connecting' more than 770 local governments as areas; no local government office said to be on it

note: Investor pre-qualification notice for a national fibre network that is to reach more than 770 local governments; it does not say any local government office is or will be connected.
